items.quote: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian
items.claim: Moses tended the flock of Jethro, who was his father-in-law and the priest of Midian.
items.object: Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian
items.mechanism: pastoral labor within a kinship relationship (son-in-law herding for father-in-law)

items.quote: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of God, even to Horeb
items.claim: Moses led the flock to the far side of the desert and came to Horeb, called the mountain of God.
